ws_data = wb_vals["Data"]

ws_lookup = wb["Lookup"]

# Years are the horizontal headers in the Data sheet; values to return are on Excel row 14.
# In this workbook, the visible year headers are on row 4 and may be merged over adjacent columns.
year_header_row = 4
target_data_row = 14

def normalize_year(v):
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return int(v) if float(v).is_integer() else v
    try:
        f = float(str(v).strip())
        return int(f) if f.is_integer() else f
    except Exception:
        return str(v).strip()

# Build year -> row-14 value map.
# Since the year headers are merged over a block and the desired value may be under the
# adjacent column inside the merged header, use the first nonblank value in row 14 under
# each year block, before the next year header.
year_cols = []
for c in range(1, ws_data.max_column + 1):
    y = normalize_year(ws_data.cell(year_header_row, c).value)
    if y is not None:
        year_cols.append((y, c))

year_to_value = {}
for i, (year, start_col) in enumerate(year_cols):
    end_col = (year_cols[i + 1][1] - 1) if i + 1 < len(year_cols) else ws_data.max_column
    val = None
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        candidate = ws_data.cell(target_data_row, c).value
        if candidate is not None:
            val = candidate
            break
    year_to_value[year] = val

# Helper to get Lookup years; data_only formulas may not have cached values, so evaluate
# the simple sequential formulas in column A when needed.
lookup_years = {}
for r in range(2, 13):
    v = ws_lookup_vals.cell(r, 1).value

        raw = ws_lookup.cell(r, 1).value
        if isinstance(raw, str) and raw.startswith("="):
            # The formulas here are of the form =A(previous_row)+1
            prev = lookup_years.get(r - 1)
            if prev is not None:
                v = prev + 1
        else:
            v = raw
    lookup_years[r] = normalize_year(v)

# Fill only Lookup!B2:B12.
for r in range(2, 13):
    y = lookup_years[r]
    result = year_to_value.get(y, "")
    ws_lookup.cell(r, 2).value = "" if result is None else result
